about_the_game:
Awoken by a mysterious black cat on a stormy night, Vi — an ordinary boy — is lured into the Under-Realm, a fractured world where the last remaining monsters cling to survival.

Here, a band of outcasts await the one called Vi, the savior foretold to guide them. But there’s a problem: you’re human, and trust between monsters and humans has long since shattered. Gaining their faith may prove harder than surviving the Under-Realm itself.

Forge bonds with unlikely allies and learn what they stand for, to protect the last sparks of hope in a dying world.
Or watch it all collapse into ruin.

  • Classic 16-bit Hardcore Action Combat:  Fight in real time using melee and magic against a wide range of enemies and get stronger as you fight in this Hardcore Action RPG! Dying too often could mean the end-

  • Atmospheric Pixel Art & Music: A handcrafted world filled with eerie beauty, dynamic lighting, and an original moody soundtrack.

  • Puzzle-Filled Exploration: Use your newfound abilities acquired in the Under Realm to assist you on your journey!

  • Branching Story: Some actions have weight. Potentially different endings based on what happens in your playthrough.

  • Duration: Approx. 3 hour to 8 hours of gameplay. Choices to add replayability.

short_description: Awoken by a mysterious black cat on a cold, rainy night, Vi — a seemingly ordinary boy — is lured into a fractured world where monsters thrive and the rules no longer apply. A band of outcast monsters awaits the one called Vi, said to be their savior… but there’s a problem: monsters despise humans.
